div.div: مُسْبِغٌ , (S, A, L, TA,) in the O and K ↓ سُبُغٌ , like عُنُقٌ, which seems to be a mistranscription, copied by the author of the K, accord, to his usual practice, from the O, (TA,) A man having upon him a coat of mail such as is termed سَابِغَةٌ. (S, A, O, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
